test.create_query: CREATE TABLE jit_division (a Int64, b Int32, c UInt32) Engine = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO jit_division SELECT toInt64(cityHash64(number)), toInt32(number % 1000 + 1), toUInt32(number % 977 + 1) FROM numbers(50000000)
test.query: SELECT sum(intDiv(a, b) * 3 + c) FROM jit_division SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
SELECT sum(modulo(a, b) * 3 + c) FROM jit_division SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
